issues.issue: The same money on the statement (receipts[7] 'Rental of School Facility' 750) is category Rentals. Rentals is the user's own category for rental income; the same line must carry the same category everywhere in a report.
The user's rules give drivers education its own receipt category (Drivers Education Fees). This line is printed as tuition, so Tuition Received is defensible; detail[5] has the same question.
